add_subdirectory(SDL EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(SDLTTF_HARFBUZZ ON)
set(SDLTTF_PLUTOSVG ON)
set(SDLTTF_VENDORED OFF)
add_subdirectory(SDL_ttf EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(SDLIMAGE_ANI OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_AVIF OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_BACKEND_STB OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_BMP OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_GIF OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_JPEG OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_JPG OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_JXL OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_LBM OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_PCX OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_PNG ON)
set(SDLIMAGE_PNG_LIBPNG ON)
set(SDLIMAGE_PNG_SAVE ON)
set(SDLIMAGE_PNM OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_QOI OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_SVG ON)
set(SDLIMAGE_TGA OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_TIF OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_WEBP OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_XCF OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_XPM OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_XV OFF)
set(SDLIMAGE_VENDORED OFF)
add_subdirectory(SDL_image EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(SDLMIXER_AIFF OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_AU OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_FLAC ON)
set(SDLMIXER_FLAC_DRFLAC ON)
set(SDLMIXER_FLAC_LIBFLAC OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_GME OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MIDI OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MOD OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_MP3 OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_OPUS OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VOC OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VORBIS_STB OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VORBIS_TREMOR OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VORBIS_VORBISFILE OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_WAVE OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_WAVPACK OFF)
set(SDLMIXER_VENDORED OFF)
add_subdirectory(SDL_mixer EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

add_subdirectory(entt EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

add_subdirectory(glm)

add_library(extern INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(
	extern
	INTERFACE
		glm::glm
		EnTT::EnTT
		SDL3_mixer::SDL3_mixer
		SDL3_image::SDL3_image
		SDL3_ttf::SDL3_ttf
		SDL3::SDL3
)
